messages:
maya: Customer (acme-inc) reports 403 on SAML Assertion Consumer Service after IdP cert rotation. They see 'Recipient check failed'.
ben: Which ACS URL did they configure? Any hostname aliases or proxy in front?
maya: ACS in SP metadata: https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/consume
maya: But in our logs the incoming POST to /saml/consume has Host header app.acme-inc.net (they have a hostname alias / CDN rewrite).
devon: That mismatch can trigger recipient/issuer checks. Did they set entityID or request-signing host override on their IdP?
ankita: Also they rotated certs yesterday — could be an incomplete cert chain (IdP serving only leaf, missing intermediate). Our cert validator will reject that in some cases.
maya: Support repro steps I tried (local):
```
# simulate SAML POST to our SP endpoint
curl -v -X POST https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/consume -F 'SAMLResponse=@saml.xml'
```
maya: SP response in logs:
```
403 Recipient mismatch: expected https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/consume got https://app.acme-inc.net/saml/consume
```
ben: Can we get them to update SP metadata to include the alias host as an additional ACS entry? Or ask IdP to send ACS with the canonical host.
devon: Short-term workaround: add ACS URL with alias host as an additional <AssertionConsumerService> in SP metadata. That's supported, but needs a config deploy and a small canary.
ankita: Also request the IdP admin to provide the full cert bundle (leaf + intermediates). Their current metadata only contains the leaf cert. Without the intermediates some SAML validators fail. :thinking_face:
maya: Customer attached their IdP metadata snippet; looks like only X509Certificate element with a single cert (no chain).
maya: @devon can you prepare a canary config to add the second ACS endpoint and a rollback plan? I'll coordinate with the customer.
devon: On it. Plan: deploy canary to 5% for tenant acme-inc with config patch:
```
sp.saml.acs: [
  "https://app.acme-inc.com/saml/consume",
  "https://app.acme-inc.net/saml/consume"
]
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary config 'saml-acs-alias-acme' -> build 8921
ben: I'll draft a KB: "Recipient mismatch due to hostname alias after IdP cert rotation" with checklist: verify ACS locations, check Host header rewrite, request full cert bundle, re-upload metadata.
maya: Customer agreed to canary. I'll post results once we see successful assertions. :thumbsup:
